headline: Tuchel Rates Thomas Priceless, test3331 Nods Along
deck: Tuchel calls Kane irreplaceable; test3331 owns the England captain in this league.
body:
Thomas Tuchel has called Harry Kane irreplaceable, the England manager conceding another captain of his kind cannot be found. For test3331, none of that is abstract. The name over the byline is the name on his sheet.

Nothing here moves a line-up or a return. It is a manager rating the asset test3331 already holds, and the verdict is the one every owner wants read aloud. What it is worth on a Saturday is a separate matter, and the wire does not touch it.
